question: Did Broadcom's Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue beat the guidance it gave on its Q2 FY2026 call, and by how much in dollars and percent?
grading: Beat amount ±$0.1B; beat % ±0.5pp; must benchmark against the company's AI semiconductor revenue guide
answer: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue was $16.7 billion versus its Q2-release guidance of $16.0 billion: a $0.7 billion beat, or 4.375% of guidance. [G18-E1, G18-E2]

output.answer:
**Yes**, Broadcom's Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue **beat** the guidance given on its Q2 FY2026 earnings call.

| | Amount |
|---|---|
| **Q3 FY2026 Guidance (from Q2 call)** | ~**$16.0 billion** |
| **Q3 FY2026 Actual** | **$16.7 billion** |
| **Beat in dollars** | **~$0.7 billion** ($700 million) |
| **Beat in percent** | **~4.4%** |

**Sources:**
- On the Q2 FY2026 call, management guided for Q3 AI semiconductor revenue of **$16 billion** for the quarter ([247wallst.com](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/09/02/live-will-broadcom-crush-q3-earnings-tonight-after-the-market-closes)). A separate recap also notes the company expected Q2's $10.8B in AI semiconductor revenue to rise to **~$16B in Q3** ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/rafal-plewko-768248216_broadcom-avgo-ai-activity-7501017777378598912-bfs2)).
- Broadcom reported actual Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue of **$16.7 billion**, up 221% year-over-year and 54% sequentially ([Broadcom official earnings release](https://investors.broadcom.com/news-releases/news-release-details/broadcom-inc-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-financial) and [Motley Fool transcript](https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/09/09/broadcom-avgo-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript)).
